name: Ola Finance Fuse lending ERC-677 borrow reentrancy
summary: Ola's Compound-fork CToken.borrowFresh sends the underlying before recording the debt. On Fuse the bridged WETH, WBTC, USDC and BUSD are ERC677 tokens that call the recipient's onTokenTransfer, so the attacker's helper borrowed against its oToken collateral and, from the callback, moved that collateral to another contract while the comptroller still saw no debt, then redeemed it and repeated across the markets.
notes: The anchor is the attacker's trial from deployer 0x09546c4a about 2.4 hours before the main drain: its helper supplied 0.3 WETH, borrowed 0.002 WBTC and sent the oWETH out from the WBTC callback, leaving the debt unbacked; 0xf91174f8 then redeemed that WETH. The same operator's earlier contracts since March 27 only minted and redeemed. The main attacker 0x371d7c9e followed with helper contracts calling the same withdraw selector.

Both targets run delegate 0xd3f5070d, set when each delegator was created and listed (blocks 13081607 and 13081609) and never changed. The anchor borrowed from oWBTC against oWETH collateral, so it needed oWETH's collateral factor, set from 0 to 0.7 by _setCollateralFactor 37 blocks after listing; that sets the age (the main drain also borrowed WETH against oWBTC, whose factor was set four blocks earlier). Later comptroller and delegator events up to the exploit are admin handovers, rain-maker and oFUSE collateral-cap changes, and both markets' interest-model swaps, none of which the exploit needed.

Loss is the six markets' gross depletion across the attacker's transactions, priced via DefiLlama's CoinGecko quotes at each transaction (DefiLlama has no Fuse token history). After the first wave the attacker supplied 550.4461473 stolen WETH to oWETH (0xc508e714), borrowed 200,000 fUSD and 1,240,000 FUSE against it, then drained the same WETH back through the reentrancy; that WETH is a round trip and is subtracted, while the two borrows, never repaid and left against collateral the attacker took back, are listed in the campaign and counted.
